Keeps screen, CPU and Wi-Fi awake while Wi-Fi is on and the watch is plugged in. Switching Wi-Fi off or unplugging turns this setting off, including after updates and restart. Re-enable manually. Cannot unlock the watch or keep it awake while powered off.
